entities.summary: Mulla Shams ad-Din Muhammad ibn Hamzah al-Fanari, 1350–1431, known in short as Molla Fenari was an Ottoman logician, Islamic theologian, Islamic legal scholar, and mystical philosopher of the school of Ibn ʿArabī.
